ShortDescription.Value: Responding emergency vehicles stop despawning in traffic jams and re-route around congestion.

Publish.LongDescription:
Vanilla Cities Skylines II deletes a responding fire engine, ambulance or police car outright once it is flagged as stuck in traffic, and never re-evaluates its route after dispatch. This mod keeps responding units alive and re-routes them around congestion using the game's own pathfinding.
Source (open source, MIT): https://github.com/AmicusDeus/EmergencyPriority
Localized into 11 languages (German, Spanish, French, Italian, Japanese, Korean, Polish, Portuguese-BR, Russian, Chinese Simplified & Traditional). Translations are machine-generated — corrections welcome.
Made with Claude Code's Opus 4.8 and Fable 5 models.
Publish.ChangeLog:
v1.06 - Stuck responders stop asking for a new route over and over
- FIX: a fire engine, ambulance or police car sitting in a jam could keep requesting a new route every few seconds for as long as the jam lasted, without ever getting anywhere. The cause is that the game works out congestion from a rolling average for that time of day rather than from the traffic actually there right now, so a jam that has just started is barely visible to it, and asking again can simply hand back the road the vehicle is already stuck on.
Now each repeat request from a vehicle that has not moved waits twice as long as the one before: about 10 seconds, then 20, 40, 80, and 160 at most. The first request is unchanged, because that is the one most likely to help - conditions really may have changed since the vehicle was sent out. The moment the vehicle moves again it goes straight back to being fully responsive.
It never stops trying, so a responder still gets going when the jam finally clears.
